title: Demo Guideline: Abnormal Potassium Follow-Up
text: For an elevated potassium result, clinicians should confirm specimen quality, kidney function context, medication contributors, and whether urgent symptoms or ECG review are relevant.

title: Demo Guideline: Diabetes Follow-Up
text: For elevated A1c or diabetes follow-up, clinicians commonly review medication adherence, hypoglycemia history, diet, kidney function, and recent glucose trends before changing therapy.

title: Demo Guideline: Blood Pressure Review
citation_label: Local demo guideline, blood pressure review
text: For hypertension follow-up, clinicians should compare recent blood pressure readings, symptoms, adherence, medication list, and cardiovascular risk factors.

title: Demo Guideline: Medication Review
text: Medication reconciliation should compare the active medication list with patient-reported use, allergies, recent discontinuations, and high-risk medication conflicts.

title: Demo Guideline: Allergy Review
text: Allergy review should clarify the triggering agent, reaction type, severity, timing, and whether the listed allergy conflicts with any current medication.

title: Demo Guideline: Red Flag Follow-Up
text: When entering the room, clinicians should ask about current symptoms, recent changes, medication use, allergies, and any red-flag concerns suggested by chart or intake evidence.
